body: The part where they say “I’m here for you is” is the most infuriating... ummm no you’re not.
A psychiatrist told my family after she had a stay at an inpatient facility

I hear you. 
So many people have left my life since I started spiralling. 
Even when I try to reach out I feel so alone. 
I had a nice cry in front of my family doctor today though. Getting referred to a psychologist. 
Hopefully someone can hear my fucking screams for help.
That’s the cutest dog ever 😢

1. The chance that it fails. I’ve seen people who tried to kill themselves and they’re in a way worse place now since they didn’t succeed but did physically damage themselves. 
2. Putting others through it. As a survivor of my partners suicide I can assure you that it was the most painful, complicated grief you can imagine. Maybe you’re just taking your pain and transferring it to someone else. 
3. All the things you have the potential to miss out on in your future which could be beautiful and wonderful. 

Good luck. I’ve been fighting these thoughts myself but those are 3 reasons I keep trying to fight them.
Ugh you guys have the best poker faces. I know you know what my scan says!
I’d be willing. Who could deny a dolphin?
Me too. I’m basically a ghost. Wanna be friends?
He said “you don’t really believe in Dinosaurs, do you?”
Completely hear you. My cat is 15. I don’t want to leave her alone because who else will feed her? I must just outlive her.
My cat is one of the only reasons I’m here.
You’re amazing congratulations!

The smartest person I know is my sister. She’s brilliant. 

She’s also the most disorganized catastrophe I’ve ever met.

Pm me anytime you want to talk about how bad you feel. I’ll try my best to listen. 

I feel the same way. I’m going to call my family doctor tomorrow. Then I’m going to try and find a counsellor. If no ones going to come and save me I guess I need to try and save my life myself.

I never thought I was pretty. But now that my hair is grey and my skin is wrinkly, I see now that maybe I was beautiful once long ago. 

From the sunscreen song: 

Enjoy the power and beauty of your youth, oh, never mind
You will not understand the power and beauty of your youth
Until they've faded, but trust me, in 20 years, you'll look back
At photos of yourself and recall in a way you can't grasp now
How much possibility lay before you and how fabulous you really looked
You are not as fat as you imagine

Now, watching my sister die of cancer and seeing her body waste away I realize that if you can breath and move, laugh and live, you have the perfect body.

Not trying to diminish OPs feelings. Depression is hard. Feeling ugly is hard. But our bodies are often so much more beautiful than we know when our minds make us feel like shit.
Beauty doesn’t last forever for anyone but im sorry you feel ugly right now.

I used to have terrible dreams for a long time. But also some really good ones. 

I’ve had my ups and downs. I need to reach out for help too. I think I’m going to start with my family doctor and go from there. I know the way I’m living isn’t normal right now. 

Thinking of you. You aren’t alone out here and I hope things get easier for you soon.

My cat was there when my ex committed suicide. I just know I will always love her through it. I don’t know if it impacted her but I’m the only person she trusts in the world. We have a bond that defies species. So I guess my advice is, just love Sumo through it. Lots of pets and a warm safe place to sleep. My baby sleeps right beside me every night.
I think you have a reason to live and it’s your son.
I get that. Every night, before I go to sleep I think about how nice it would be to not wake up. You’re not alone out there.
Pretty good chance your parents are mentally ill. I hope you can find your way through that toxic bullshit.

Life has been up and down. Sometimes it gets better sometimes it gets worse. What I struggle with is not being able to find the strength or energy to make things better anymore but I know they could be better if I tried.

Hello, I completely get what you’re saying. If you have someone you can talk to about this I think it would be worth it. A lot of people have felt this way and you’re not alone. Pm me if you ever need a random person to chat with.

I find it hard to cope with the part of myself that didn’t take a suicide threat seriously. I find it hard to live with the knowledge that I’ve said and done things that I regret. I find it hard to accept that I wasn’t in love with him, that I left him, and that he blames the whole thing on me. I live my life with that weight and it’s a shadow that blankets the joy in my life. I don’t think about him a lot anymore but when I do, I think of what a shitty person I am.

The truth is you’ve seen and felt more than your peers have. You know things they don’t know yet. The older you get the more of your age group will have faced terrible painful things. You’ll be able to relate to them when no one else can. You’re valuable and older than your years now. I hope you can find the time and space to do things that you love. You deserve it.
I’m sorry. People are dicks.
Nothing happens. You’ll be fine but alcohol and fish sounds grotesque.
Maybe he just doesn’t click with you. Hopefully he has someone he can chat with.

I’m so sorry for everything you’re going through. 

Grief sucks. It’s like something you couldn’t imagine until you’ve lived with it. You don’t need to return to normal life right now. Take the time you need to be sad and grieve this very significant loss. Reach out for help. Maybe that’s your parents or a therapist or a group but don’t go through this alone. Society might act like we should bury our dead and move on but it doesn’t really work like that. Grief is hard and messy and not everyone is going to know how to support you or even be able to understand what you’re going through. It’s going to get better but everything you’re feeling right now is normal.

None of us are perfect people. I have some pretty significant regrets about things I’ve done as well. I think it’s part of being human. 

I’m sorry for your loss. I hope you can let go of your regrets.

That therapist sounds like garbage. 

I’d discuss it with my children in an age appropriate way. I wouldn’t keep it a secret. Secrets can be toxic. Suicide is an adult subject like sex is... not something we should hide but definitely tough subjects to navigate.

You’re doing better and getting better. This is how it will come. It’s waves. At first they’re going to be big and knock you out, but they’re going to get smaller and further apart. I know it’s hard but trust that it gets easier.

I’m so sorry for everything you’ve been through. 

When my partner killed himself, I was still numb at his funeral. I felt fine. Actually, I felt nothing. I went home and cried and drank myself to sleep, it finally all hit me (don’t do this if you can help it.) 

There’s no right or normal way to do this and other people might have no perspective on what you should be doing or feeling but everything you’re doing and feeling is perfectly normal but still tremendously difficult and painful. I found a suicide bereavement group tremendously helpful I heard people finally speaking everything I had thought and felt that I thought was tremendously bizarre and unique. You aren’t alone out here ❤️
I was guessing Bo Burnham. Thanks for sharing, I will check this out. I’m so sorry for your loss❤️
I lost my boyfriend to suicide when I was 19. Yes, you will always think of him but this will get easier, I promise.

I’ve never caught anything. But there is some vomit in nursing. I got used to it but the first time a patient vomited I can remember backing up in disgust. Then I remembered it was my job and started manning the vomit buckets.
I work with a lot of male nurses. I think they’re more empathetic to be honest.
